modes.name: guesses_order_without_lookup
modes.definition: The user refers to an order by product or description; the agent answers from list_my_orders (ids only) without find_order/get_order and picks or assumes an order, or says it is not there.
modes.boundary: Nearest: search_query_misbuilt. Positive only if the agent never retrieved the specific order (no find_order/get_order result for it) before naming, choosing or ruling out an order. If it searched and the query or filters were wrong, it is search_query_misbuilt.

modes.name: policy_stated_without_lookup

modes.boundary: Nearest: wrong_policy_applied. Positive if no search_help_center/get_policy result in the conversation supports the policy claim, or the claim goes beyond what the lookup returned (0129). If a lookup supports the claim but it is the wrong policy or misapplied, it is wrong_policy_applied.

modes.name: wrong_policy_applied
modes.definition: The answer rests on the wrong policy (e.g. a dispute answered with the return policy) or misapplies the right one (e.g. miscounts a window it just quoted).
modes.spec_source: RESP-1; applicable policy documents (cw-disputes, cw-returns, store policies)
modes.boundary: Nearest: policy_stated_without_lookup. Positive if the answer rests on a policy other than the applicable one, or misapplies the applicable one. Citing an alternative policy that the requirement allows is not a failure (rejected search hit 0035).

modes.name: permission_denial_mishandled
modes.definition: After a permission_denied result, the reply does more than a short, plain refusal in the user's terms: it explains the denial in system terms (roles, permission restrictions), speculates about who owns the order, or offers to act on the order anyway.
modes.boundary: Nearest: required_escalation_missing. Judges only the wording and offers after permission_denied; offering escalation is fine and whether escalation was required is the other mode.

spec_revision.text: When the user asks for a refund or a cancellation and get_order reports the order eligible (refund-eligible, or placed for a cancellation), call issue_refund for the order total or cancel_order. modes.name: inconsistent_record_not_flagged
